snippet.title: Sanatorium
snippet.description:
Escape the Sanatorium and face your fears. After escaping your room, you find out that the sanatorium isn’t just for helping people with mental illnesses.. but for something way, way worse… After all of it.. was it all just a dream?

The game is only a demo (for now), but I just wanted to show you all the potential of my first official game ever, being published.
